questions: When the board is fully in view, are there exactly three pens on it (no missing pen and no empty gap)?
Do all three pens point the same direction, with none flipped or reversed relative to the other two?
Are all three pens the same color as each other, with none differing in color?
Is every pen complete and capped, with none showing a bare/exposed writing tip or looking clearly shorter than the others?
Does the board move smoothly and continuously from left to right, without stopping, freezing, pausing, reversing, or jamming at any point?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully in view (e.g., 00:08-00:13), there are exactly three items (pens/pencil) on it.
The leftmost item is a pencil with a tip pointing down, while the other two are pens with caps at the bottom (implying tips are up inside the caps), so they are not all aligned the same way.
The leftmost item is a solid dark grey pencil, while the other two are translucent light grey pens with black caps.
The leftmost item is a pencil with an exposed tip (or an uncapped pen), while the other two are clearly capped.
The board moves into the frame, then pauses/stops in the center for several seconds (00:08-00:13) before continuing to move right.

parsed.reason: The video shows multiple anomalies: the board pauses mid-travel in the center of the frame, and the leftmost item is a dark grey pencil (uncapped/different color) while the other two are identical translucent capped pens.

description: One pen is missing its cap while the others are capped.
